annotations.title: Record that an email was sent

description: Record in Fundz that the user sent an outreach email from their own mailbox, so the lead shows as Contacted in the Fundz app and is flagged before anyone writes to that person again. Call it only after the user confirms the email was actually sent, never for a draft. It sends nothing itself. A setup test email sent to the user's own address is fine to pass here: Fundz recognises it, records no outreach, and tells you what to have the user check. Fundz allows three touches per contact; a fourth is refused with the reason. After it records, the result may tell you to ask the user whether to schedule the follow-ups: always finish your reply with that question when it does, even if the user only asked you to send and record.
